articulation.label: problem
articulation.alt: problem: /p/ → /r/ → /ɑ/ → /b/ → /l/ → /ə/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
